pageDescription: Re-designed and developed the EarthX website, an environmental non-profit organization.
fbOgSiteName: I'm Tam. A Interactive Designer in DFW.
workDescription: EarthX is an environmental organization that promotes an exposition held every year in Fair Park Dallas TX. Through the agency, I was tasked to redesign their website for EarthX for 2019 to 2021. The site featured exhibitions, attractions, films, conferences, educational content, art competitions, events, news, on-demand video and an online store. Most of the event content was fed through a highly customized event calendar app that also operated as a shcedule. In addition, I helped increase online presence by improving their SEO, and integrated Okta Single Sign-On that would allow users to access multiple applicatons using one account.
